headline: Approved first reading of revised policies EBCF and GDB-9, engineering firm BIMS, and Richard Fournier as Bangor High School principal.
summary: Approved the interim principal hire, the July and August 2026 financial reports, and the September 10 meeting minutes. Also approved extra-duty assignments and four donations to schools. Members asked for information on inter-school waivers, school holds, and the McKenney Vento program.
decisions: Approved Building Infrastructure Management Solutions (BIMS) as the engineering firm to provide services to Bangor School Department, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved authorization for the Superintendent to hire an Interim Principal, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved the draft minutes of the September 10, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved the July 2026 Financial Report, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved the August 2026 Financial Report, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved the administrator nomination of Richard Fournier as Principal of Bangor High School for the 2026-2027 school year, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved the extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 school year for Joni Buck (Retired), Nicole Downing, and Sam Picard, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved four donations shared by Ben Sprague: $240 to Vine Street School, $250 and $500 to Downeast School, and $100 to James F. Doughty School, by a 7-0 vote.
Approved first reading of Revised Policy EBCF (Automated External Defibrillators) and Revised Policy GDB-9 (Supplemental Compensation Guide), by a 7-0 vote.

transcript:
# MINUTES

# BANGOR SCHOOL COMMITTEE

## REGULAR MEETING

7:00 p.m., Wednesday, September 23, 2026

School Committee Members Present: Chair Tim Surrette, Vice Chair Katie Brydon, Mallory Cook, Sara Luciano, Shelly Okere, Ben Speed, and Ben Sprague.

A. 1. & 2. The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m. by Chair Tim Surrette and the pledge of allegiance followed.

B. Adjustments to the Agenda:

No adjustments to the agenda

C. Public Comments:

No public comments

D. 1. a. Recommendation to approve the Building Infrastructure Management Solutions (BIMS) as the engineering firm to provide services to Bangor School Department.

Motion: Brydon  Second: Sprague  Vote: 7-0

b. Recommendation to approve authorization for the Superintendent to hire an Interim Principal.

Motion: Brydon  Second: Sprague  Vote: 7-0

D. 2. a. Superintendent Robinson provided a district update to the committee

E. 1. a. 1. Recommendation to approve the draft Minutes of the September 10, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting.

Motion: Brydon  Second: Okere  Vote: 7-0

b. 1. Director Hale provided an overview of the financial reports.

2. Recommendation to approve the July 2026 Financial Report.

Motion: Brydon  Second: Okere  Vote: 7-0

3. Recommendation to approve the August 2026 Financial Report.

Motion: Brydon  Second: Okere  Vote: 7-0

c. 1. Recommendation to approve the following administrator nomination for the 2026-2027 school year:

- Richard Fournier, Principal, Bangor High school

Motion: Brydon  Second: Okere  Vote: 7-0

2. Recommendation to approve the following extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 School Year.

- Joni Buck (Retired), (1.75) IEP Coord, Fairmount School
- Nicole Downing, (.9) IEP Coord, William S. Cohen School
- Sam Picard, (.9) IEP Coord, William S. Cohen School

Motion: Brydon  Second: Sprague  Vote: 7-0

c. Committee Member Ben Sprague shared the following donations:

- To Vine Street School from United Way, backpacks with supplies to support students, having a total dollar value of $240.
- To Downeast School from General Electric, Community Service Team, backpacks and school supplies to support students, having a total dollar value of $250.
- To Downeast School from Eastside Center for Health and Rehabilitation, food, snacks and school supplies to support students, having a total dollar value of $500.
- To James F. Doughty School from Peter and Debra Burke, a cash donation to support students, having a total dollar value of $100.

Motion: Sprague  Second: Surrette  Vote: 7-0

E. 2. a. 1. Recommendation to approve First Reading of the following Revised Policies:

1. Revised Policy EBCF – Automated External Defibrillators
2. Revised Policy GDB-9 – Supplemental Compensation Guide

Motion: Okere  Second: Brydon  Vote: 7-0

H. Member Sprague congratulated Dr Butler and Mr Fournier on their new roles.

Member Sprague requested information and data on inter-school waivers and school holds.

Member Cook requested information about the McKenney Vento program now that it has been assigned to a new administrator.

Member Speed asked if there was an update on bus drivers/transportation issues.

Member Sprague announced there is a ribbon cutting at the new Fairmount playground tomorrow.

Member Speed acknowledged the Bangor Beautiful Mural at the Fruit Street School.

Member Okere wished Mr Fournier well on his new position at the High School and also acknowledged the Fruit Street mural.

I. 1. Important dates were reviewed by Chair Tim Surrette.

J. Recommended to adjourn the meeting at 7:40 p.m.

Motion: Brydon  Second: Okere  Vote: 7-0

Respectfully Submitted,

Marie Robinson, Ph.D.
Superintendent of Schools
